'''''Star Wars: Jedi Quest''''' was a four-issue series of comics published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] between [[September 12]], [[2001]] and [[December 12]], 2001. The same story was also told in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Quest (novel series)|Jedi Quest]] series of young adult novels, in the ''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]'' special edition. This series has not been collected as a trade paperback, but was eventually collected in ''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Menace Revealed]]''.
